tools.name: llm.setup
tools.description: Write the llama.cpp profile for this host's llm server. Does not start it and does not load decision models.

tools.name: llm.models
tools.description: List llm weights in the shared library, free space, and the disk reserve from core/home/policy.json.

tools.name: llm.config
tools.description: Read the GGUF header for one llm weight. Does not load the model.

tools.name: llm.usage
tools.description: Read recent llm probe and call rows from the home usage log. Rows have no prompt text.

tools.name: llm.download
tools.description: Download one GGUF from a Hugging Face repo into the shared library. Refuses a file that exists, a path outside the home, or a file that would pass the disk reserve.

tools.name: llm.remove
tools.description: Delete one llm weight from the shared library. Refuses a file that a decision model still names.

tools.name: llm.sample
tools.description: Run the two short probes from core/home/policy.json on one llm weight and at most two other llm weights. Does not start the server.

tools.name: llm.check
tools.description: Check the llm unit recorded by llm.setup.

tools.name: llm.uninstall
tools.description: Delete the llm folder under the self-hosted home. That folder holds the install, config, and state llm.setup wrote. The shared models library stays.
